source_requirement: Allow viewing, filtering, sorting, editing, and deleting records.

clause_evidence.view: Live ForEach reads full store.history; record cards render original result/unit/reported date/optional metadata and notes; no record prefix limit.
clause_evidence.filter: Existing hormone picker passes its selected controlled hormone to the actual store query. New executed chronological/filter regression covers both hormone choices and empty match.
clause_evidence.sort: New live historyOrder picker forwards newestFirst/oldestFirst through observed store to persistence. Executed query regression verifies both directions, same-day deterministic ties and no writes.
clause_evidence.edit: Per-record button freezes .edit(measurement), opens actual editor and saves through store.save(updated,locale:intent:). Executed store tests verify edits, restarts and rejection of stale/deleted/recreated identities.
clause_evidence.delete: Per-record button enters owned requestDeletion(.one(id)); confirmed action calls store.delete(id:). Existing executed persistence tests cover actual single deletion, no-op missing IDs, dropped writes and changed-snapshot protection.

not_run: Apple compilation and complete visible view/filter/sort/edit/delete flow.
